investigation.original_website_failure: YouTube request failed after about 2.56 seconds; previous logs did not retain detailed subprocess error.
investigation.root_cause: Not established; do not label the runtime gap as the confirmed cause.
investigation.local_reproduction: Exact worker successfully downloaded the supplied link.
investigation.old_cloud_image_reproduction: Same image also successfully downloaded the video in Cloud Build: 108598256 bytes.
investigation.confirmed_environment_gap: Old cloud image reported no supported JavaScript runtime; local machine has Deno.

changes.youtube_setup: Pinned Deno 2.9.6 copied from official binary image; yt-dlp[default] includes matching yt-dlp-ejs 0.8.0.
changes.formats: Prefer existing H.264/MP4 + compatible audio, then allow native fallback formats. Remux supported codecs or transcode unsupported video/audio into H.264/AAC MP4 as needed.
changes.guards: Existing admin size limit, total 240-second runtime budget, temporary workspace limit and cleanup remain. Conversion rejects size-limited truncated output rather than returning a shortened clip.
changes.diagnostics: Drain subprocess output into at most 32 KiB of memory; only known reason codes and safe metrics enter structured logs. No raw URLs, query tokens, cookies or subprocess output in production logs.

validation.real_conversion: FFmpeg WebM VP9/Opus conversion produced H.264/AAC; compatible MP4 bytes stayed identical.
validation.privacy: Tested failure logs omit signed URL and token text.

cloud_and_release.synthetic_webm_vp9_opus: Converted to H.264/AAC MP4 in the built Linux image.
cloud_and_release.runtime: Deno 2.9.6 and yt-dlp-ejs 0.8.0 verified; missing-JS-runtime diagnostic false.

release.authenticated_website_retest: User retry still needed; original 422 cause was not reproducible.
